text: He who thinks a great deal is not suited to be a party man: he thinks his way through the party and out the other side too soon.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche
visual_brief: An architectural plan view in precise white technical linework showing an intricate, closed labyrinthine floorplan, pierced straight through the center by a single, perfectly straight transit line with directional arrows that enters one wall and exits the opposite side without turning.
alt: Technical plan showing a straight path cutting clean through an intricate maze
